notablePrerequisites:
One additional card in hand.
Your life total is greater than your starting life total.
description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to activate it, creating token copy of Drogskol Reaver.
Discard a card to activate Mind Over Matter, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Pay {3}{W}{W}{W} to cast Transcendence.
Transcendence's second ability triggers.
In response, tap Kiki-Jiki to activate it, creating a token copy of Exquisite Archangel.
Resolve Transcendence's ability modified by the token Exquisite Archangel's replacement effect, exiling the token and reducing your life total to your starting life total.
Transcendence's second and third abilities each trigger.
Resolve its third ability, gaining life equal to twice the amount you lost.
The token and nontoken Drogskol Reavers each trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Discard a card to activate Mind Over Matter, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to activate it, creating a token copy of Exquisite Archangel.
Repeat from step 6 until there is one card remaining in your library.
Discard a card to activate Mind Over Matter, untapping a land you control.
Tap that land to add one mana.
Repeat the previous two steps three more times, until you have a total of {2}{W}{U} available.
Pay {W} to cast Scout's Warning, letting you cast your next creature spell as though it had flash and drawing a card.
Pay {2}{U} to cast Laboratory Maniac.
Repeat steps 6 through 9 one more time, modifying a Drogskol Reaver ability with Laboratory Maniac's replacement effect.
